fact: At a 30 October 2026 review, Libreville's E-Tax platform (launched 12 June 2026) was operating in 15 capital markets with about 2,000 traders enrolled in a register and over 4,000 transactions, each with an official receipt.
title: E-Tax : la Mairie de Libreville dresse un premier bilan de la collecte numérique des taxes de marché
